content.body:
I have not run into any modern code that actually waits for these events, besides web platform test code, so I'm not sure it's as important. It feels like something from the early 2000s when people were coordinating independent script loads with <script> tags, instead of using whole-app bundlers.

But, I don't think they hurt.
Yeah, `<script defer>` mostly ate the use-case for listening to DOMContentLoaded. I suppose the document's load event is still reasonable to listen to, in some cases.
